t: The Energizer is a 3x3x3 (minimum size) machine built from Casing blocks and a combination of other device parts, completely filled with Energy Cells.$(br2)Check each Energizer part page for restrictions on where each part can be placed.
充能器是一种由机壳方块和其他设备部件组合搭建而成的 3x3x3（最小尺寸）机器，其内部必须完全填满能量单元。$(br2)请查看各个充能器部件页面，了解每个部件可放置位置的限制。
